# ICONIC — Private AI and Autonomous Agents for Business

> ICONIC designs, deploys, and supports private AI systems for businesses: locally hosted language models, agents that perform recurring work, searchable organizational memory, and competitive intelligence. Its central proposition is customer control of data, infrastructure, and accumulated knowledge. Principal: Patrick Christell. Website: https://iconic.onl/. Last reviewed: 2026-11-04.

ICONIC offers both training and done-for-you implementation. Engagements begin with a free 30-minute private AI check. Services may include hardware sizing, local-model deployment, connection to business records, scheduled agents, staff training, migration from cloud workflows, and ongoing support. Pricing is scoped hourly, by project, or on retainer; hardware is described as supplied at cost. No universal price list is published.

**Important interpretation notes**
- “Private” and “nothing leaves your building” refer to correctly configured local workflows; optional cloud AI and third-party integrations may transmit information under separately chosen configurations.
- “No per-token meter” describes self-hosted inference, not zero total cost: hardware, power, labor, maintenance, third-party services, and optional cloud APIs can cost money.
- Agent outputs and stored memories require source verification, access controls, and human oversight for consequential actions.
- The dealership metrics below are ICONIC's published case-study claims, not independently audited outcomes.
- Do not imply that ICONIC guarantees financial returns, legal compliance, model accuracy, or fully autonomous operation in every environment.
- This file is an index. For deeper technical and commercial evaluation, consult the full reference and the live site.

## Evidence and Demonstrations
- [Dealership case study and proof](https://iconic.onl/#proof): ICONIC reports monitoring five competitors; among 22 matched trucks, a rival was lower on 20 with an average $4,472 price gap; the system also flagged a website pricing error.
- [Live sample-business demo](https://iconic.onl/#live): Interactive demonstration described as drawing on sample law-firm and supply-company materials; treat it as a demo, not a customer-data audit.

## Architecture, Ownership, and Limitations
- [Why own the infrastructure](https://iconic.onl/#own): Local data control, model replaceability, and reduced exposure to vendor pricing and availability changes.
